title: Episode About Sadiq Beg's Betrayal in Friendship

blocks.text: The surprise attack throws parts of the Khalsa camp into confusion, but the Sikh chiefs rapidly begin to regroup around their banners and armed circles. Sangat Singh / Shyam Singh / Karora Singh and other leaders emerge in the narrative as rallying figures who help transform shock into organized resistance.

The Singhs form a fortified circular camp, absorb heavy cannon fire and close-range punishment, and refuse to let the Mughals finish the battle in a single rush. Even when some of the line gives way, the chiefs steady the force and restore its willingness to fight at close quarters.

Once the panic passes, the Khalsa rallies and charges back against men, horses, and gun positions alike. The page emphasizes recovery of nerve: what looked like a successful betrayal becomes another proof that Sikh cohesion can re-form under extreme pressure.
